paragraph: A partly backed sell is split: matched quantity takes FIFO cost and pro-rata proceeds (realised result); unmatched quantity keeps unknown basis and its proceeds; whole-transaction SOL fees are allocated by quantity (matched = original * matched_qty / qty; unmatched = original minus matched) so integer/decimal totals are preserved. Whole-sale P&L stays unresolved. Analytics emit the split rows (not one collapsed signature). The labelled fee-free fixture (6 tokens cost 36 USDC; sell 10 for 100) accounts 60 proceeds = +24 matched and 4 unmatched = 40 unknown-basis; 100 is fully accounted. Fully backed, partly backed, fully unbacked, and multi-lot cases agree with the independent tool (algorithm-independent, shared decoder). Results are labelled conditional on captured inventory through UI, compare, saved reports, and export.
